sources.label: Personal Morphe patches for Android
sources.author: Dyno
patch_list: Hide piracy warning
Removes the "This CamScanner copy is not genuine" dialog and toast. The app's internal genuine/pirate state is left alone, so nothing re-routes features.
Remove ads
Blocks every CamScanner ad position at the interceptor choke point (app launch, main/share/page banners, doc list, scan-done and rewarded inventory). Ad SDKs stay bundled but receive no requests.
Remove PDF watermark
Stops the Scanned with CamScanner watermark from being drawn into exported and shared PDFs. The local document is otherwise produced by the same native PDF engine, unmodified.
Spoof app signature
Reports the original signing certificate to the app so tamper and licence checks pass.
Unlock premium

Reports a local VIP / super-VIP account status and sync entitlement, unlocking the features CamScanner gates behind its subscription check on device. Cloud credits, Word/Excel conversion and other server-side work stay validated remotely.
